relevance.rationale: A survey presenting an expanded version of a classical list of Rogers--Ramanujan type identities, together with later discoveries and older identities from the lost notebook, earliest-known references for each, false theta function identities, and the dependence relations among identities. This is the same broad neighbourhood as the corpus's q-series work -- and one already-registered corpus reference does connect dilogarithm identities to Rogers--Ramanujan-type partition identities via their asymptotic behaviour -- but the corpus itself has essentially no Rogers--Ramanujan content: a grep across content/ and docs/audits/ turns up no block or audit that states, uses, or needs such an identity. Without a place that wants one, a catalogue of several hundred identities is a lookup table with no consumer here, and citing it would be decorative. Scope note (a): this document, as read, supplies nothing usable at present. That is explicitly not a claim that Rogers--Ramanujan machinery is excluded -- if a future Nahm-sum or character-asymptotics route opens in the corpus, this catalogue becomes the right first stop, which is why the verdict is tangential rather than not-relevant.
